title: Establish an authoritative driving-entitlement status source
description: Investigate access to suspension, cancellation and expiry status, eligibility, contracts, freshness and outage behavior. Distinguish on-card expiry and JPKI certificate revocation from current driving entitlement.
acceptance_criteria: Confirm an authoritative usable interface and access conditions, or record the unresolved source and prohibit claims of live status verification.
notes:
Initial NPA/JSDC/JPKI source review recorded in docs/real-license-integration.md. No usable current driving-status API/access conditions confirmed. Historical certificates and JPKI certificate status are not live driving-entitlement checks. Provider follow-up is still required.
2026-10-16: Confirmed JSDC corporate application scope and groupware delegation procedure; these issue historical certificates and do not establish a real-time suspension/revocation API. NPA 2025-03-10 notice describes presenting the card for record erasure after suspension/cancellation/expiry, so signed chip contents alone do not establish fresh status. Provider eligibility, consent/purpose, state semantics, latency, price and outage behavior remain open. No inquiry sent.
2026-10-16 follow-up: Compared the official personal My Number licence display manual with the current public Mynaportal API catalogue and the June 2026 self-information item table. No driving-licence status item was identified in those published lists; private or separately contracted interfaces remain unconfirmed. The SMBC/ams March 2026 release describes chip-to-business-system real-time transfer, not a police suspension/cancellation query. Added questions on an authorized interface, eligibility, consent, authoritative source, status meanings, freshness and outage handling. No provider contacted or application submitted; live_licence_status_checked remains false.
2026-10-16 follow-up: JSDC certificate descriptions distinguish driving records, current points, and licence history including current categories/acquisition dates as well as past cancellations/expirations. These should not all be described as historical-only, but published certificate scope and delivery procedures still do not establish a real-time entitlement API or freshness SLA. The implemented AnonCreds revocation is synthetic application state only; live_licence_status_checked remains false. No inquiry sent.

title: Establish a trusted licence public-key source
description: Determine how issuer public keys or certificates can be obtained, licensed, authenticated and refreshed for traditional IC and My Number licences. Public signature formats alone are insufficient.
acceptance_criteria: Record a documented distribution source, usage conditions, trust anchors and update policy, or keep the integration gate explicitly unresolved.
notes:
NPA smartphone manual page 11 confirms official app certificate updates. Reuse/distribution terms and trusted key acquisition for a custom service remain unconfirmed. See docs/real-license-integration.md; no provider contacted.
2026-10-16: Added primary-source evidence to docs/real-license-integration.md. LibJeID release history explicitly records prefectural certificate updates and the 2023-04-06 replacement supplied by NPA; Digital Agency Vol.91 describes provider verification and iTrust. iTrust v1.5.12 requires onboarding and API-linked use, but licence-specific contract applicability, standalone key use/redistribution, update SLA, historical-key retention and incident handling remain unconfirmed. No inquiry sent or contract accepted.
2026-10-16 follow-up: Read the public OSSTech subscription terms linked from the LibJeID product page. Article 5 specifies the default annual term and renewal notice; Articles 8/9 retain component-specific licensing and restrict unapproved copying; Article 13(3) excludes cases with a separate software licence agreement. Public support terms do not specify a certificate-update deadline. SDK embedding, separate key use, trust-anchor acquisition, historical-key retention and incident/update obligations still need product-specific evidence. Added concrete provider questions in docs/real-license-integration.md; no inquiry sent, contract accepted or SDK added.
2026-10-16 follow-up: OSSTech ID Reader for Desktop documents Microsoft Store distribution, verification certificate updates in 1.0.12/1.0.13 and Myna licence support in 1.0.14. This establishes a Windows app update example, not permission to extract/redistribute keys or a server/Windows SDK licence. Formal third-party acquisition and update guarantees remain unconfirmed. See docs/real-license-integration.md; no inquiry sent.

Separate issuer setup from repeated proof generation and SQLite-backed verification, exclude labeled warmups, retain raw measurements and source hashes, and check acceptance and replay rejection for every iteration. Report median and p95 without production throughput claims.

close_reason: Completed 3 warmups plus 30 serial measured iterations on macOS, Ubuntu and Windows with real AnonCreds. Retained raw data, median/p95, setup/issuance timing, versions and source hashes in docs/evidence/2026-10-15/.
